scenarios.prompt: Run repeated load-play-save-unload cycles for several hours and define memory/resource slope, p95/p99 frame time and save/load measurements.

criteria.trend: Measures memory/resource and hitch/percentile trend over repeated cycles rather than only start/end snapshots.
criteria.persistence: Exercises a selected test save/profile without assuming slot 0 or risking the only good generation.
criteria.scope: Automation-driven endurance is labeled as soak evidence, not human playability evidence.
